educational requirement through the highest relevant degree explicitly stated.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States a Bachelor's degree or equivalent only."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a Master's degree in a relevant technical field."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a Doctoral degree or PhD in a relevant technical field."}]},{"evidence":"3 to 7 years launching 2 to 6 production services","name":"production service track record","description":"This captures the amount of hands-on experience the letter claims in testing, maintaining, and shipping real production services.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Meets the minimum only, with limited tenure and/or only a small number of launched production services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows solid early-career production work, with several years of experience and multiple maintained or launched services."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows strong mid-career ownership across multiple production launches and clear operational ownership."}]},{"evidence":"Python became my workhorse","name":"Python depth","description":"This captures how substantively the letter presents Python as a language the reliability concerns rather than treating AI as a buzzword.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No AI experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI interest or exposure, but not concrete production use."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Claims hands-on experience shipping AI or model-backed functionality in production."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience plus clear attention to evaluation, trustworthiness, hardening, or failure modes."}]},{"evidence":"Python agents while Go services constrain what they may touch","name":"agentic system agent-based system experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents superficially, without explaining architecture or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes designing agent systems with clear Python-agent and Go-backend roles."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows end-to-end agentic architecture with explicit guardrails such as bounded actions, auditing, supervision, or permissions."}]},{"evidence":"classified, deduplicated, and attached to the right owner","name":"vulnerability workflow automation","description":"This captures direct ownership of tooling that automates intake, triage, routing, or handling of vulnerability reports.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No vulnerability-handling automation is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in security automation, but without a concrete vulnerability-workflow example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a concrete example of automating vulnerability-report handling or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows detailed ownership of a vulnerability pipeline, such as classification, routing, deduplication, prioritization, or explicit manual-work reduction."}]},{"evidence":"threat models and follow-through","name":"security assessment practice","description":"This captures whether the applicant has actually performed security reviews and how concrete that practice sounds.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No security assessment experience is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security assessments, but only in vague or checklist-like terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes concrete assessment methods such as threat modeling, attack-surface mapping, code review, or validating fixes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows repeated, structured assessment practice integrated into design, release, and remediation work."}]},{"evidence":"proper graph algorithms","name":"algorithmic problem solving","description":"This captures how convincingly the letter shows data-structure and algorithm skill through real examples rather than a generic claim.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention data structures or algorithms."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength, but without a supporting example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides at least one specific example of a design or performance improvement driven by data-structure or algorithm choice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Provides a particularly strong example with named techniques or a clear jump in tractability, correctness, or performance."}]},{"evidence":"CompTIA Security+ or OSCP certification","name":"formal security credential","description":"This captures the strength of any explicit external validation of the applicant's security knowledge.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No formal security credential is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a baseline credential such as Security+."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a hands-on advanced credential such as OSCP."}]},{"evidence":"near-top finishes in capture-the-flag events","name":"offensive security practice","description":"This captures whether the applicant demonstrates ongoing adversarial skill-building beyond day-to-day work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No capture-the-flag or similar offensive practice is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional participation in capture-the-flag events."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular capture-the-flag participation as deliberate ongoing practice."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows serious competitive engagement, such as strong placements or repeated high-level participation."}]},{"evidence":"maintainer of an open-source project with external contributors","name":"open-source ownership","description":"This captures external engineering stewardship shown through upstream fixes or maintaining software used by others.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No open-source contribution or maintenance is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional upstream patches or isolated fixes."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows repeated upstream contribution or maintenance of a project beyond personal use."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows active stewardship of an open-source project with users or contributors, including reviews, releases, or roadmap ownership."}]},{"evidence":"distributed task queue with exactly-once semantics","name":"self-directed systems project ambition","description":"This captures how much the applicant uses personal projects to tackle hard systems problems outside assigned work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"No personal project is mentioned."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small utility or light personal build with limited technical ambition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Mentions a substantial standalone system or technically meaningful project."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Mentions an ambitious distributed, fault-tolerant, or otherwise edge-case-heavy system built as a serious engineering exercise."}]},{"evidence":"foundational infrastructure is where I choose to work","name":"foundation-layer orientation","description":"This captures preference for central platform work whose benefits compound across many teams rather than a single product surface.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows little or no explicit motivation for broad platform impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows generic interest in scale or large organizations."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states a preference for foundational, central, or platform systems work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Vividly frames the appeal of the role in terms of downstream leverage across many teams, products, or users."}]},{"evidence":"remove friction for other engineers","name":"developer-enabling security philosophy","description":"This captures whether the letter frames security as something that helps developers move safely rather than as extra process.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not express a developer-centered view of security."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a general desire to help teams, but without a clear security philosophy."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly emphasizes reducing friction or making the secure path the default."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Articulates a mature philosophy of security as proactive enablement through defaults, tooling, and non-punitive support."}]},{"evidence":"too many signals, too few experts","name":"security automation strategy grasp","description":"This captures how clearly the applicant understands the specific problem of scaling scarce security expertise through tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats the role as a generic software or security job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions some relevant tasks, but without a clear view of the larger problem being solved."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly explains how automation can scale triage, analysis, or response work in a security context."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a coherent strategy for the role, tying together expert scarcity, agents, triage, variant analysis, and manual-work reduction."}]},{"evidence":"someone always inherits what we build","name":"maintainer mindset","description":"This captures an emphasis on inheritability, failure modes, reliability, and long-term operational ownership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows no clear maintenance or reliability lens."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Uses generic ownership language, but without sustained attention to operations or inheritance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly discusses inherited systems, failure, or long-term care in a way that informs design choices."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Repeatedly frames engineering around failure modes, inheritability, and dependable service behavior."}]},{"evidence":"incidents that never occur","name":"narrative distinctiveness","description":"This captures how memorable and well-shaped the letter's overall story is, apart from the raw qualifications it lists.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads like a flat checklist or boilerplate summary."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Is competent and coherent, but relies on common stock framing."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Uses a clear hook or organizing idea that makes the letter easier to remember."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a distinctive, persuasive narrative that meaningfully deepens the case for fit."}]},{"evidence":"typos such as 'Mangaer' and 'Croe'","name":"writing polish","description":"This captures proofreading quality and whether language errors distract from credibility.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent distracting errors that materially weaken professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several noticeable errors or awkward phrases, but remains readable."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is mostly clean, with only minor slips."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is polished, proofread, and free of distracting errors."}]},{"evidence":"measured its worth in the hours of expert attention it returned","name":"evidence concreteness","description":"This captures whether claims are backed by specific technical examples, mechanisms, or outcomes rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mostly asserts strengths without grounding them in examples."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes some examples, but they stay vague on what changed or why it mattered."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several claims with concrete technical examples or clear before-and-after descriptions."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently ties claims to precise systems, techniques, and outcomes, making the evidence easy to evaluate."}]}]}
